I.value_zh: 已给出的 Dev.to URL、主页第 16 篇文章列表及可能列出第 16 篇的 README 索引；主页和 README 的文件路径、现状和第 16 篇定位未提供。
I.value_en: The supplied Dev.to URL, homepage’s sixteenth-article list and any README index that may list article sixteen; homepage/README paths, current state and article-sixteen location are not supplied.
I.notes_zh: 不读取仓库状态或假定 README 条件成立。
I.notes_en: Repository state is not read and the README condition is not assumed.

O.value_zh: 主页及条件成立时 README 索引中的第 16 篇 Dev.to 链接，且 GitHub 原文链接与外部链接清晰区分；目标文件和现有索引条件未定。
O.value_en: The article-sixteen Dev.to link on the homepage and, if the condition holds, README index, with clear distinction between GitHub original and external links; target files and existing-index condition are undetermined.
O.notes_zh: 不得创建未要求的索引。

A.value_zh: 将指定 Dev.to 链接加入主页第 16 篇文章列表；清晰区分 GitHub 原文与 Dev.to 外部发布链接；如 README 索引已列第 16 篇则同步补充。
A.value_en: Add the specified Dev.to link to the homepage article-sixteen list; clearly distinguish GitHub original and Dev.to external-publication links; synchronize it only if the README index already lists article sixteen.
A.notes_en: No Dev.to access or publication occurs.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 为要求方；ME 为收件人和被指派主体。
P.value_en: ADMIN is requester; ME is recipient and assigned actor.

R.value_zh: 优先级 P2；无时限或资源预算。
R.value_en: Priority P2; no deadline or resource budget.

V.value_zh: 原文声明英文文章已发布并给出 URL；未提供仓库索引规则或外部发布可核验依据。
V.value_en: The source says the English article was published and provides a URL; no repository-index rule or verifiable external-publication basis is supplied.
V.notes_zh: URL 仅为原文事实，不进行网络核验。
V.notes_en: URL is only source fact and is not network-verified.

C.value_zh: 主页/索引可见第 16 篇的对应 Dev.to 链接，且不提交 `.env`；因主页/README 文件与条件未定，验收无法唯一决定。
C.value_en: Homepage/index shows the article-sixteen Dev.to link and `.env` is not committed; acceptance cannot be uniquely decided because homepage/README files and condition are unspecified.
C.notes_en: Target index state must be frozen.
